detail.longDescription: Hi, my name is Pricila, im from Rio de Janeiro, Brasil. I'm trying to improve my English and also study programming more deeply. Today I have knowledge in PHP, but I want to build a foundation in Python so I can take bigger flights lol I don't see much of a future in PHP these days, but never say never, right? I also study the poor thing in parallel 😅 Obviously I won't start from Hello, world , but I also don't know how to begin studying Python based on the premise that nowadays AI does everything! I'm even feeling discouraged, honestly... Anyway, I intend to document my studies here, playing around with English and Portuguese, because I still don't know written English that well # sad But that's it, welcome to my space 🏡💖 (Online schizophrenic) # programming # python # javascript # beginners # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community Welcome - Bem vindo(a) 🌸
